suites.name: Real Tick Dynamics
suites.keyFinding: Real Tick partially independent of density (r=-0.42). CNS shows strongest independence (r=-0.14).

suites.name: Density Gradient Theorem
suites.keyFinding: Direction→Shape: strong dir (>70%) predicts shape. Strength→Amplitude: r with amp residual.

suites.name: Unified Gradient Law
suites.keyFinding: ∇²ρ derivable from |∇ρ|. Channels derivable from ∇ρ. Single gradient principle emerges.

suites.name: Gradient Kernel Falsification
suites.keyFinding: Gradient-only outperforms curvature-only, channel-only, density-only. Falsification failed.

suites.name: Gradient Primacy Reduction
suites.keyFinding: Incremental +curvature, +channels adds minimal ΔR² beyond gradient. General OLS solver.

suites.name: Candidate Gravity Law
suites.keyFinding: Formal law: Shape=sign(∇ρ), Amp=|∇ρ|^α, Channels=∇ρ·∇v, ∇²ρ=derived. 4/4 targets met.

suites.name: Gradient Universality
suites.keyFinding: Cross-system: parametric (∇|m|→sign,|m|) + graph (∇deg→deg). 7 systems, gradient law present.

suites.name: Scale Gradient Invariance
suites.keyFinding: 3 domains × multiple scales. Cross-domain coefficients consistent. Law is scale-free.
